recognize_zh: 低倍（A）見周邊血小淋巴球明顯增多；高倍（B）的淋巴球核成熟、染色質塊狀，淡藍色胞質中可見細長平行的絲狀（filamentous-like）條紋包涵體，屬 CLL 細胞少見的胞質包涵體變異。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis of small mature-appearing lymphocytes at low power
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing fine, parallel filamentous or striated inclusions (panel B)
Cells with angular, irregular cytoplasmic outlines
Background red cells normochromic; smudge cells not prominent in these fields
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes (panel A). At high power (panel B), the lymphocytes have round to slightly indented nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm that contains fine, parallel, filament-like inclusions. No prominent nucleoli, azurophilic granules, or villous projections are seen. In the context of a CLL immunophenotype, findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with unusual filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, which may represent immunoglobulin or crystalline material.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have oval/bean-shaped nuclei with more open chromatin and circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections, and are CD5 negative, CD103/CD11c/CD25/annexin A1 positive.
SMZL cells show polar villous projections rather than intracytoplasmic filaments and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with basophilic cytoplasm and possible Dutcher/Russell bodies, with MYD88 L265P mutation, not CD5+/CD23+ CLL phenotype.
MCL cells often have irregular, notched nuclei with more dispersed chromatin and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD23 negative.
